judged_text: The new PollFeed job's core behavior — fetching the feed, the link/id URL fallback, unescaping item content, and delegating to TopicEmbed.import — has no test anywhere in the diff (spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb only exercises the enable/disable guards). adjudication.rationale: The diff adds substantial logic in `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` (requiring `simple-rss`, `SimpleRSS.parse open(...)`, iterating `rss.items`, URL fallback to `i.id`, `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`, and calling `TopicEmbed.import`). The only added spec `spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb` exercises only the `execute` guard conditions and the delegation to `poll_feed`, but does not test any of the feed-fetch/parse/item-loop behavior. Given `recurrence { hourly }` and `sidekiq_options retry: false`, a break inside the loop could go unnoticed by tests as the finding describes.
